name: smwsprites-albatoss-bomber-boss
title: Albatoss Bomber Boss
description:
An Albatoss Bomber who takes 3 hits (by thrown objects) to defeat. Additionally, it can walk faster after each HP. It will change direction after crossing 16 units of blocks (1 screen).

You can increase the HP by setting the value of HP_COUNTER to something else in the INIT routine. Make sure you increase the number of bytes in the "RightSp" table if you do that though.

Requested by SomeGuy
